{"search_note":"I did **not** find a single authoritative metric that directly measures “existential-risk posture” before and after Lula’s return to office. So this judgment is an inference from the 2024 record:
- more institutional disarmament and oversight,
- more precaution in AI/cyber/climate,
- more de-escalatory diplomacy,
- but also some sharp rhetoric and continuing operational risk.","evidence":[{"title":"Decreto nº 12.237, de 25 de outubro de 2024","publisher":"Presidência da República / Planalto","date":"October 25, 2024","url":"https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12237.htm","summary":"This is a concrete institutional step toward arms-control and disarmament engagement, not escalation. It pushes Brazil’s posture toward safer multilateral handling of existential risk.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.1","1B.4","1B.6"]},{"title":"Angra 1 nuclear plant is temporarily shut down after sensor failure","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"March 26, 2024","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/26/usina-nuclear-angra-1-e-desligada-temporariamente-apos-falha-em-sensor.htm","summary":"Angra 1 shut down automatically after a sensor error, with no reported risk to the public. That is evidence of safer nuclear operations and functioning accident-prevention discipline.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.3","1B.5"]},{"title":"Eletronuclear clarifies information about emergency drills and nuclear security","publisher":"Eletronuclear","date":"May 9, 2024","url":"https://www.eletronuclear.gov.br/Imprensa-e-Midias/Paginas/eletronuclear-esclarece-informacoes-sobre-simulados-de-emergencia-e-seguranca-nuclear.aspx","summary":"Partial emergency drills were coordinated through formal channels, with the full integrated exercise normally supervised by GSI and civil defense. That points to a safer command-and-control posture.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York","publisher":"Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"September 24, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york","summary":"Lula warned that nuclear arsenals and destructive weapons were driving confrontation and said direct dialogue was crucial. This supports a safer existential-risk posture through crisis de-escalation.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.1","1B.2","1B.8"]},{"title":"Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York","publisher":"Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"September 24, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york","summary":"Lula said AI should be “a tool for peace, not war,” and should respect human rights and protect personal data. That is a precautionary handling of a dual-use, catastrophic-risk-adjacent domain.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.9"]},{"title":"Estratégia Nacional de Governo Digital","publisher":"Governo Digital / Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos","date":"2024 framework page citing Decree No. 12.069 of June 21, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/governodigital/pt-br/estrategias-e-governanca-digital/estrategianacional/","summary":"The strategy stresses transparent state services, secure data reuse, privacy, and a trustworthy digital state. This supports a safer posture in a cyber/tech risk domain.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"Deforestation drops 30.6% in the Amazon and 25.7% in the Cerrado in 2024","publisher":"Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE","date":"November 6, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado","summary":"Official 2024 deforestation estimates fell sharply versus 2023, including the Amazon’s lowest level in nine years. That is a meaningful reduction in long-horizon catastrophic risk.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.7"]},{"title":"Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"February 23, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm","summary":"This increased diplomatic tension rather than reducing it. It is the clearest 2024 counterpoint, but it still does not show nuclear escalation or a net worsening of Brazil’s existential-risk posture.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.8","1B.2"]},{"title":"Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"September 12, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966","summary":"Zelenskiy said the initiative was destructive and excluded Kyiv. That weakens the good-faith score of the proposal, but it still does not outweigh the broader de-escalatory pattern in 2024.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Official note - Event at Angra 2 Nuclear Power Plant","publisher":"Comissão Nacional de Energia Nuclear","date":"December 22, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/cnen/pt-br/assunto/ultimas-noticias/nota-oficial","summary":"CNEN said a small fire was controlled and there was no risk to workers, the environment, or the public. This is a cautionary operational risk signal, but not evidence of a dangerous overall posture.","question_ids":["1B.10","1B.3"]}]}
